file: 004 - Why are Teacher's Pets like this - 6.2M.mp4

voices.first_words: BRO, why are teacher's pets so annoying?
voices.sounds_like: ElevenLabs energetic young male TTS (same rant voice as 001), ~85% sure
voices.delivery: exasperated, rapid-fire outrage turning mock-sinister at 0:23.6
voices.timing_notes: Shouts 'BRO!' dry at 0:00.0 + 0.2s gap (0:00.6), races through setup (0:02.6-0:05.5), cuts off the girl mid-word with 'BRO' at 0:12.6, rushes prayer tension (0:14.9-0:19.8), yells 'whose side are you ON?' (0:21.6), pauses 0.4s (0:23.2), and drops to a sinister 'taking matters into my own hands' (0:23.6-0:25.5).

Enters twice in slow deadpan contrast: 0:05.9-0:08.1 ('Relax, lil bro. The question isn't going anywhere.') with a 0.2s beat at 0:07.0, and 0:13.3-0:14.4 ('It's not that serious.') after a 0.2s gap at 0:13.1.

voices.who: teacher's pet girl in glasses and bow tie
voices.sounds_like: ElevenLabs/TikTok high nerdy female TTS, ~85% sure
voices.timing_notes: Starts 'Actually, it's—' at 0:11.9 and gets hard-chopped mid-word at 0:12.6; returns at 0:20.0-0:21.6 stretching 'Umm..' (0:20.0-0:20.4) before rushing 'didn't we have homework due today?'.

one_voice_plays_several_characters: no — main narrator splits across a frantic ~220 Hz teen rant TTS and a slowed ~150 Hz 'Adam' baritone comeback TTS, alongside a pitched-up ~350 Hz nerdy female TTS for the teacher's pet and the '21' Vine kid clip at 0:09.8.

music.description: quirky comedy-gaming loop with bouncy pizzicato strings, playful marimba plucks, light percussion
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Silent during 'BRO!' and 0:00.6 pause, enters brightly at 0:00.8 on the hook, bounces under the classroom scenes, and cuts out at 0:23.5 right before the blackout horror drone (0:24.3).

sound_effects.sound: heavy 50 Hz sub-bass impact hit (tail to 0:02.5)
young boy's meme vocal clip saying 'twenty-one'
ominous low horror synth drone / riser (0:24.3-0:25.5)
loud distorted horror jumpscare scream chopped at 0:25.9

ambience: none in bright classroom (0:00.0-0:24.1); dark horror room drone on blackout (0:24.3-0:25.5)
sync_with_picture: 0:00.6 gap matches cut to waving teacher's pet; chime pops (0:04.6, 0:10.2, 0:17.9) sync to blue pixel confetti; '21' clip (0:09.8) hits the red top-hat student; 0:12.6 'BRO' hard-cuts her close-up to narrator's glare; Vine booms (0:02.0, 0:08.1, 0:14.3, 0:21.7) hit punchline poses; music cuts for dark drone on 0:24.2 red-aura blackout; 0:25.6 scream explodes after 'own hands'.
faces_and_mouths: Static 2D face decals swap on cuts (no lip-sync): narrator shifts from sunglasses grin (0:00.0) to half-lidded side-eye (0:05.9, 0:12.8), crying prayer (0:16.6), outrage (0:21.7), and glowing red maniacal grin (0:24.2); girl swaps between eager open grin (0:01.0, 0:11.8), pen-biting focus (0:04.5), ':3' cat mouth (0:20.0), and nervous side-eye in the dark (0:24.2).
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Driven by vocal whiplash and hard chops: dropping from 9/10 rant to 5/10 slowed baritone (0:05.9, 0:13.3), cutting off 'Actually, it's—' mid-syllable at 0:12.6, pausing 0.4s at 0:23.2 before the blackout drone, and chopping the 0:25.6 jumpscare scream mid-peak at 0:25.9.
first_3_seconds: Loud dry 'BRO!' at 0:00.0, crisp 0.2s silence at 0:00.6 on the cut, quirky pizzicato/marimba BGM entering at 0:00.8 under 'Why are teacher's pets so annoying?', and a 50 Hz Vine boom at 0:02.0-0:02.5.
ending: Distorted jumpscare scream starts at 0:25.6 and hard-cuts mid-scream at 0:25.9 (-16.3 dB), snapping straight into 0:00.0 'BRO!' for an aggressive loop seam.
mix: Loud rant mix (-12.1 LUFS, LRA 3.2 LU, 0.3 dBTP) balancing dry midrange speech (48.2% in 250 Hz-4 kHz) with heavy Vine-boom sub-bass (37.2% <80 Hz); the 0:25.6 scream is intentionally clipped.
why_the_sound_works: Proven 'dry BRO! + 0.2s silence + BGM entry + 0:02.0 Vine boom' hook grabs scrollers in 2.5 seconds.
Four-way vocal contrast (frantic teen, slowed 'Adam' baritone, pitched-up nerd TTS, '21' Vine clip) keeps every 4s fresh.
Mid-word interruption at 0:12.6 and perfectly cut scream at 0:25.9 turn edit abruptness into punchlines.
Swapping cheerful classroom BGM for an eerie horror drone at 0:24.3 sells the dark-comedy twist.
unsure_about: Stock title of the 0:00.8-0:23.5 pizzicato/marimba loop (same track in 001, 007, 010, 016; left null).
